name: Shrinebark Pilgrimage
introDiscord:
Old shrine trees line a ceremonial route through the forest. Their bark
is covered in offerings left by generations of travelers, while
Shrinebark Guardians quietly watch each step.
introTwitch:
Old shrine trees line a ceremonial route through the forest. Their bark
is covered in offerings left by generations of travelers, while
Shrinebark Guardians quietly watch each step.

shrinebark-pilgrimage-approach.prompt: Three pilgrimage paths climb between carved roots and faded offerings.

left.message:
Restorative sap rests in a folded ceremonial leaf.

Shizuki left one shiny pebble beside it and wrote:

'Borrowed medicine.

Left payment.

Pebble excellent quality.'
left.fullHpMessage:
You leave the restorative sap and Shizuki's premium ceremonial pebble
undisturbed.

right.message:
A Shrinebark Guardian steps from beside the path and taps its staff
against the root once.

You do not know the rule you broke.

Unfortunately, it does.

forward.message:
A moss-covered shrine coffer contains Star Candies beneath dozens of
old travel tokens.

Shizuki's pebble is somehow the shiniest offering.

shrinebark-pilgrimage-depths.prompt:
Towering kelp columns rise around three deeper pilgrimage routes.
Ancient carvings suggest travelers once stopped at every shrine.

left.message:
One Berry rests inside a tiny offering bowl.

Shizuki wrote:

'Left Berry for shrine.

Got hungry.

Replaced Berry.

Ate replacement.

Bought third Berry.

THIS is third Berry.

Do not continue cycle.'

right.message:
An offering basket hidden inside an old root contains Star Candies and
several polished shells.

forward.message:
A Shrinebark Guardian raises one hand in silent warning.

You bow.

It pauses.

Then still attacks.

Etiquette only gets you so far.

shrinebark-pilgrimage-threshold.prompt:
Living rootways lead toward Old Bark Sanctuary. Three paths cross
beneath ancient prayer ribbons.

left.message:
A Guardian kneels beside a shrine.

As you approach the final route, it stands.

Very slowly.

Very ceremonially.

Still a problem.

right.message:
A tranquil grove pool sits beneath Shizuki's note:

'Pilgrimage status:
Respectful.
Mostly.
Glimmer wore offering ribbon as cape for ten minutes.'
right.fullHpMessage:
You leave the pool untouched. No further ceremonial incidents are
required.

forward.message:
Broad silver kelp wraps a cache of Star Candies beneath a carved image
of the oldest roots.

boss-antechamber.name: Old Bark Sanctuary
boss-antechamber.prompt:
Every Shrinebark Guardian along the pilgrimage kneels toward the oldest
tree.

bossPromptDiscord:
The bark of Old Bark Sanctuary begins to glow.

Ancient carvings awaken one by one as the roots split around a towering
figure that has stood within the tree for longer than the surrounding
shrines.

Use /yes to approach the Sanctuary or /no to leave the oldest Guardian
to its watch.
bossPromptTwitch:
The bark of Old Bark Sanctuary begins to glow.

Ancient carvings awaken one by one as the roots split around a towering
figure that has stood within the tree for longer than the surrounding
shrines.

Use !yes to approach the Sanctuary or !no to leave the oldest Guardian
to its watch.
bossRetreatText:
You step away from the Sanctuary. The old carvings dim, and the
Guardians remain kneeling.

boss.revealText:
The ancient bark opens and a massive guardian steps from the heartwood.

First-Root Guardian reveals itself!

completionText:
"The First-Root Guardian returns to the ancient tree.

The pilgrimage route opens ahead.

Shizuki's shiny pebble remains on the shrine.

Accepted, apparently."
